newsitem.title: USA: AT&T WorldNet extends plan, expands another.
newsitem.headline: AT&T WorldNet extends plan, expands another.

text.p: AT&T Corp's AT&T WorldNet Service said Wednesday it is extending its free five-hour pricing plan to March 31, 1997, while expanding its $19.95 plan, effective today, for unlimited access to anyone in the U.S.
The company said in a release that the $19.95 unlimited access pricing plan is being expanded to not just AT&T long distance customers, but to anyone with a computer and modem in the United States.
It said that the free five-hour plan is being extended three months beyond its original deadline of December 31, 1996, in response to continuing high demand.
It added that it was being extended as an "additional incentive for people receiving (personal computers) and software products as holiday gifts" to try out the Internet.
